subject.title: Hard-delete or runtimeId migration needed for @apify/apify-openclaw-plugin

question: Should an authorized ClawHub admin apply the guarded runtime-ID repair to the production Apify package after verifying publisher authority and target availability?
rationale: The code capability is already present, but changing executable-package identity in production requires authorized human action and package-specific security checks.

options.title: Apply guarded repair
options.body: Dry-run and then apply the existing repair from `apify` to `apify-openclaw-plugin`, followed by live API and publish verification.

options.title: Hard-delete and republish
options.body: Delete the package only if maintainers explicitly accept losing package continuity and the resulting ownership and republish consequences.

recommendation.title: Apply guarded repair
recommendation.body: Dry-run and then apply the existing repair from `apify` to `apify-openclaw-plugin`, followed by live API and publish verification.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored both relevant repair mechanisms and performed the analogous production operation.
